text_block_list.text:
Today, Голд Сити wanted a change of
scenery, so
I took her out for the day.
On our way back to the
academy...

Hey, Trainer. Isn't there anywhere else
you want
to go?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: All that's left is to head back...

text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Is there somewhere you wanted to drop by?

text_block_list.text: Not especially. That's why I asked you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
One time, when my manager was driving
me to
work after school, we passed by
some students in
uniform.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I could hear them from inside the car.
They were
talking about how their
evening out was just
getting started.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It was already getting dark, so it was
like, how are
you "just getting started"
when places are about
to close?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But they sounded like they were literally
having
the time of their lives, and it just
stuck with me
even after I got to the
studio.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Well, if it isn't City. You two out and
about too?
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Inari. No, we're actually on our way
back.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Whaaaat?! You're goin' home? The
party's just
gettin' started!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
You're missin' out! C'mon, follow me! I'll
show you
how to spend the evenin'.
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: We might as well. Maybe we'll learn something.

text_block_list.text: Are you sure?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Your trainer knows what I'm talkin'
about!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
City, you ready? Time is money, so we
gotta run
at top speed!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: W-wait, Trainer can't keep up with us...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: I'll meet you at the destination.
You two go have fun together.

text_block_list.text: Well... if you say so.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What's gotten you all concerned? You
wanna stay
with your trainer that much?
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: I-it's not like that! I'm not a child!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Haha—you're right, though. If we're
gonna have
fun, we should all enjoy it
together—especially
when it comes to
watchin' a race!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
Huh? But it's a weekday, and it's already
late.
Tokyo Racecourse won't be hosting
any...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
What do you mean?! Don't tell me you
forgot
another one of our great
racecourses!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Whoa...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, can you feel the energy? Oi
Racecourse
is where dirt and spirit come
together to dance.
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
By the way, are you on that Umagram
thingy too?
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: I'm on Umastagram, if that's what you mean...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh, then you wanna go take some pics?
There's
this supposedly great spot Falco
won't stop
talkin' about.
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
Falco, huh? Then it's probably
somewhere
picturesque, yeah? Heh,
Jordan might be into it
too.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Also, there's lots of interestin' foods to
try. Why
don't we take a look around?
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do it!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on! The field's entering the
paddock
for the next race!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh my gosh, which should we check
out? I'm
literally so torn!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Haha, such an innocent soul. You must
be havin' a
blast.
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
That's what I like to hear, Trainer!
Sounds like you
know exactly how to
have fun after school.
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
The trick is—no grown-ups allowed! Us
students
need our time to ourselves!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list:
Just send me a text whenever you're ready to
come back.

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, City, don't let this chance go to
waste.
Let's go!
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
I part ways with Голд Сити. Later, after
doing
some shopping at the shopping
district...
Oh, Trainer. You're on your way back?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Yup! First we hit up the arcade, then we
got
honeyade, then we went to a public
bath, and...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're way too excited. Look,
you're scarin'
your trainer.
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити's cheeks are flushed. It seems
she really
enjoyed her time out on the
town.

What's this? Has the sight of a lass fresh
out of
the bath rattled your noggin?
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm askin' if you're swooning at the sight. You got that dreamy look on your face.
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: What are you saying, Inari?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hey now, hey now, what're you gettin' all flustered for? Your trainer's standin' right in front of two drop-dead beauties here.
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text:
Or what, did you think you were the
only one?
text_block_list.name: Inari One

text_block_list.text: Ugh, Inari!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити blushes as Inari One laughs
teasingly.

Голд Сити's eyes twinkle with excitement
like a
child's.
